word.title: Concept Header for the Concept of Nostr Kinds

conceptHeader.description: A Nostr kind is an integer field on a Nostr event (0–65535) that classifies the event's purpose and replaceability. Key kinds: 0 (user metadata/profile), 1 (short text note), 3 (follow/contact list), 7 (reaction), 10000 (mute list). Replaceable events (10000–19999, 20000–29999) may be overwritten by a newer event from the same pubkey. Parameterized-replaceable events (30000–39999) are addressed by kind:pubkey:d-tag and include DList events (39998/39999) used by Tapestry.
